sentences.en: Being a historian is sort of like being a detective.
sentences.zh: 当历史学家有点像当侦探。

sentences.en: You hunt around for little scraps of information,
sentences.zh: 你四处搜寻零星的信息碎片，

sentences.en: clues you can use to try to piece together a more complete story of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 利用这些线索试图拼凑出一段更完整的过去。

sentences.en: You dig through old meeting minutes, receipts, and business transactions.
sentences.zh: 你翻阅旧的会议记录、收据和商业交易单。

sentences.en: You read old diaries and leaf through old letters.
sentences.zh: 你阅读旧日记，翻看旧信件。

sentences.en: And when you can, you try to get your hands on actual physical objects from history.
sentences.zh: 只要有可能，你就会尝试获取历史上真实的实物。

sentences.en: This part can prove particularly difficult
sentences.zh: 这一部分往往非常困难，

sentences.en: because the materials of everyday life are usually lost to the sands of time.
sentences.zh: 因为日常生活中的物品通常都湮没在历史的尘埃中了。

sentences.en: Seth Rockman is a professor of history at Brown University,
sentences.zh: 塞斯·洛克曼是布朗大学的历史学教授，

sentences.en: and recently he was looking for clothes that were worn by enslaved people in the American South,
sentences.zh: 最近他一直在寻找美国南方被奴役者所穿的衣服，

sentences.en: which was proving impossible because those items just didn't survive.
sentences.zh: 但这被证明是不可能的，因为那些物品根本没能留存下来。

sentences.en: They didn't survive because, of course, in most cases they were used into oblivion.
sentences.zh: 它们没能留存下来，当然是因为在大多数情况下，它们被用到彻底报废为止。

sentences.en: Through hard labor or through various forms of recycling,
sentences.zh: 通过繁重的劳动或各种形式的回收利用，

sentences.en: a garment that had worn out might be ripped into shreds
sentences.zh: 一件穿旧的衣服可能会被撕成碎片，

sentences.en: and some of it stuffed into holes in a wall to insulate
sentences.zh: 其中一些被塞进墙上的洞里用来隔热，

sentences.en: or stuffed into the toe of a shoe or made into a bandage.
sentences.zh: 或者塞进鞋尖里，又或者被做成绷带。

sentences.en: As a result, very little of the clothing that was worn on slave plantations
sentences.zh: 结果，在奴隶种植园里穿过的衣服，几乎没有一件

sentences.en: And even if it had, we'd still be unlikely to find it
sentences.zh: 即使留存下来了，我们也很难找到它，

sentences.en: because many of the cultural institutions that have been devoted to preserving the American past,
sentences.zh: 因为许多致力于保存美国历史的文化机构，

sentences.en: their collection practices in the late 19th and early 20th century would have had no interest in this.
sentences.zh: 它们在19世纪末和20世纪初的收藏实践中，根本对这些东西不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Oh, look, I have a garment that an enslaved person wore.
sentences.zh: 噢，看，我有一件被奴役者穿过的衣服。

sentences.en: Come back when you have something that George Washington wore.
sentences.zh: 等你有了乔治·华盛顿穿过的东西再来吧。

sentences.en: It would be more likely what you'd hear.
sentences.zh: 这才是你更有可能听到的话。

sentences.en: And so these goods would not be preserved in some of the collections.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些物品不会被纳入某些收藏中。

sentences.en: In fact, the clothing that enslaved people wore is so rare
sentences.zh: 事实上，被奴役者穿过的衣服非常罕见，

sentences.en: that historians have been searching for it for years.
sentences.zh: 以至于历史学家们多年来一直在寻找它们。
